integrity: The stated bound and explicit construction are derived from the given definitions. The proof uses a row-pair block inequality, not an assumption that every base clique must contain a selected vertex. Published prior special cases and the prior formulation as a conjecture are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats all integers \(n\ge1\), \(m\ge2\), and \(1\le k\le m-1\). It does not classify all minimum sets or treat \(k\ge m\); independent external audit has not been performed. Exhaustive checks are finite, while the main proof is analytic.
title: Exact limited domination of every Sierpiński graph
